clue.text: Offender priest half got into religious group

indicators.note: one piece got into the other, so the half-priest is placed inside the religious group

parts.note: a cult is a small, often unorthodox religious group

indicators.note: half of the word priest is its first three letters

explanation.surface: A churchman has drifted into some fringe sect and is to blame.
explanation.definitionFit: A culprit is the person responsible for a crime or misdeed, the one at fault.

clue.text: Houses screened for customers

parts.note: the surface suggests buildings hidden behind screens; read again, these are buildings where films are screened for paying audiences

explanation.definitionFit: Picture houses show films on a screen to a paying public.

clue.text: A match for the devil

definitions.meaning: an old friction match was called a ...
Satan's name before his fall, the light-bringer

explanation.definitionFit: Old strike-anywhere matches were sold as lucifers, and the fallen angel Satan bears the same name.

clue.text: Fetching sort of dog

parts.note: fetching looks like attractive, but it means a breed that fetches game for the hunter

explanation.definitionFit: Gundogs such as the Labrador are bred to bring back shot birds to the shooter.

clue.text: Time to think of serious crime

parts.note: to reason is to think logically

explanation.surface: A moment of reflection on grave offences.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying one's country or sovereign is among the gravest offences in law.

clue.text: Torment with slogan that sleep is wicked?

parts.note: bed stands for sleep, as in going to bed
evil means wicked

explanation.surface: A campaign slogan declaring that sleep itself is sinful, used to torment someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedevil is to plague or harass persistently.

clue.text: It's pulse may alarm the doctor

definitions.text: It's pulse may alarm the doctor

parts.words: It's pulse may alarm the doctor
parts.note: the pulse looks like a patient's heartbeat, but it is the electronic signal of a pager that summons a doctor

explanation.definitionFit: A pager carried by hospital staff emits a high beep to call them.

clue.text: Amusing peer brought up a Liberal

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the word for peer is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a lord is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A nobleman who raised a Liberal is entertaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Droll describes humour that is dry and whimsical, so it means funny in a quiet way.

clue.text: Outrage, being 6-0 behind

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
the figure zero looks like the letter O
late means behind time

explanation.surface: A sports fan is outraged that the team is losing six-nil.
explanation.definitionFit: To outrage something, as a law or a sanctuary, is to break or desecrate it.

clue.text: Set on having a baby

parts.note: set on looks like determined to, but it is a noun: a set of clothing kept ready for having a newborn

explanation.definitionFit: A layette is the complete outfit of clothes and linen prepared for a newborn infant.

clue.text: Clothing fatal to wear at US party?

definitions.text: Clothing fatal to wear at US party?

parts.words: Clothing fatal to wear at US party?
parts.note: an American lynching was grimly called a party of this name, where the noose round the neck was the deadly garment

explanation.walkthrough: In old American slang a lynching was a 'necktie party', the rope being the tie.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie is a piece of clothing worn round the neck, and the noose of a lynching was jokingly given the same name.

clue.text: Prudence as firm's admitted to money, changing

indicators.note: the firm is admitted to the scrambled money, so it is placed inside it
the letters of money are changing their order

parts.note: CO, short for company, is a firm; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Thrift, as a company lets its cash keep moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges MONEY into ENOMY, and 'admitted to' puts CO inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Economy means careful, frugal management of resources, which is thrift.

clue.text: No special uniform for Muslim jurist

definitions.meaning: civilian dress worn by someone normally in uniform
an expert in Islamic law who issues rulings

explanation.surface: A judge of Islamic law who wears no official robes.
explanation.definitionFit: Off-duty soldiers wear plain clothes called by this name, and the same word names a scholar of Islamic law.

clue.text: One comes in to replace beggar

indicators.note: one piece comes in to the other, so the letter for one goes inside the word for replace

parts.note: to supplant is to replace or oust
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A newcomer arrives to take the place of a vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A suppliant is one who humbly pleads or petitions, a supplicant asking for help.

clue.text: Absolved, having got quietly smashed

parts.note: SH is the call for silence, so it stands for quietly
riven means split or torn apart

explanation.surface: Someone forgiven for getting discreetly drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: To be shriven is to have heard confession and received absolution from a priest.

clue.text: Release 51 arrested by old officer

indicators.note: the number is arrested, held inside, by the old officer

parts.note: a reeve was a medieval local official or magistrate
LI is fifty-one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Prisoner number 51 is held by an old officer before being freed.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve can mean to free someone from duty or a burden, letting them go.

clue.text: No degrees in this to be had in London

definitions.text: No degrees in this to be had in London

parts.words: No degrees in this to be had in London
parts.note: degrees looks like university qualifications, but these are map degrees: the Greenwich meridian in London sits at zero east-west

explanation.walkthrough: The prime meridian runs through Greenwich in London, so the east-west coordinate there is zero degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: The east-west position on the globe is measured in degrees from the Greenwich meridian, which is zero.

clue.text: Provided real problems, like the US government

parts.note: fed means provided food or supplies

indicators.note: the word real is given problems, so its letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Supplying true difficulties, as Washington does.
explanation.walkthrough: 'problems' rearranges REAL into ERAL. The definition is adjectival: the US government is federal.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States has a federal system, power shared between central and state governments.

clue.text: Excited, has info giving latest style

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone thrilled to have news of the newest trend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excited' rearranges the seven letters of HAS INFO.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashion is the current vogue in dress or manners, the newest look.

clue.text: Appointed agent-that's put into legal document

indicators.note: the word put goes into the legal document

parts.note: a deed is a signed legal document

explanation.surface: An agent has been appointed, as written into a contract.
explanation.definitionFit: Deputed means appointed someone to act as a delegate on your behalf.

clue.text: She lives her life with pride

definitions.text: She lives her life with pride

parts.words: She lives her life with pride
parts.note: pride looks like self-respect, but it is a group of big cats, and she is the female of the species

explanation.definitionFit: A group of lions is a pride, and the female hunts and lives within it.

clue.text: Desire to show reverence for old weapon

parts.note: to long is to desire
to bow is to show reverence

explanation.surface: Wishing to honour an ancient arm.
explanation.definitionFit: The tall bow of English archers at Agincourt is a historic weapon.

clue.text: By lake, I'd play around with floating leaf

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

indicators.note: the words I'd play are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Beside the water, someone plans to fool about on a floating leaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' rearranges IDPLAY into ILYPAD, placed after L.
explanation.definitionFit: The broad flat leaf of a water lily rests on a pond's surface.

clue.text: British, silly chaps, make memorial tablets

parts.note: asses are foolish people

explanation.surface: Britons and foolish fellows producing commemorative plaques.
explanation.walkthrough: Church brasses are engraved brass plates set into tombs or walls to commemorate the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: Monumental engraved metal plaques in churches commemorate the dead.

clue.text: Ambushed in road, left needing help

parts.note: a way is a road or path
aid means help

explanation.surface: Attacked on the road and left in need of assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: To waylay is to lie in wait and attack someone, so waylaid means intercepted by surprise.

clue.text: Magnificent bird for US sporting highlight

parts.note: superb means magnificent
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A splendid bird is chosen for an American sports climax.
explanation.definitionFit: The championship game of American football is the biggest event in the US sports calendar.

clue.text: Sounds from bands

definitions.meaning: a bell ... or makes a resonant noise
circlets such as those worn on fingers

explanation.definitionFit: A bell's peal and circular hoops worn on fingers share the one word.

clue.text: From capital, youngsters see the country

indicators.note: the letters are taken from inside the words capital and youngsters

explanation.surface: Children from the capital go sightseeing in the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Italy is a nation of southern Europe.

clue.text: Fierce tennis played by English

indicators.note: tennis is played about, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A ferocious tennis match won by an Englishman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'played' rearranges TENNIS into INTENS, then E is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense means extreme or vehement, as fierce competition is.

clue.text: Bismarck's country, polite at first to Eastern power

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of polite

parts.note: Russia is a great power to the east

explanation.surface: The Iron Chancellor's nation is courteous towards its eastern rival.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto von Bismarck was the Prussian minister-president who unified Germany.

clue.text: They are barely able to enjoy themselves

definitions.text: They are barely able to enjoy themselves

parts.words: They are barely able to enjoy themselves
parts.note: barely looks like hardly, but it means unclothed: these people enjoy themselves bare

explanation.definitionFit: Naturists take pleasure in going without clothes.

clue.text: Changed gear?

parts.note: gear looks like a car's transmission, but it is clothing: having put on fresh clothes

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has changed their outfit has put clothes on.
